name: The majority voted against [amendments](https://parlinfo.aph.gov.au/parlInfo/search/display/display.w3p;query=Id:legislation/billhome/display.w3p;query=Id%3A%22legislation%2Famend%2Fr7462_amend_31d8838f-b333-4367-bb23-3deb924b148b%22;rec=0) introduced by the Australian Greens party, which means they were unsuccessful.
